headline: Indonesian Gold Prices Experience Decline In Early November Trading
metaDescription: Gold prices in Indonesia have decreased as of November 7, 2026, with Antam gold showing a reduction of Rp20,000 per gram in recent market tracking.
aiSummaryBullets: Antam gold prices decreased by Rp20,000 per gram on Saturday, November 7, 2026.
The new price for Antam gold is reported at Rp2,545,000 per gram.
Gold price updates for various brands, including Galeri24 and UBS, are currently available via Pegadaian.
aiContextParagraph: On November 7, 2026, gold market data in Indonesia indicated a downward trend in valuation for popular investment products. Specifically, the price for Antam gold, as monitored through the official Logam Mulia website in Jakarta, fell by Rp20,000 from its previous price point of Rp2,565,000 to reach a new level of Rp2,545,000 per gram. This price movement was recorded during morning trading hours. In addition to Antam products, consumers and investors are currently accessing updated pricing lists for other gold brands, such as Galeri24 and UBS, through the Pegadaian platform. These fluctuations are regularly reported by domestic media outlets to provide timely financial information to the public as they track commodity value changes in the national market throughout the business week.
whyItIsViral: The story reached a moderate viral activity score due to consistent reporting across primary Indonesian news outlets tracking daily commodity fluctuations.
